title: Daytona
journal:
Summers used to be so warm back then, I think because not many of us had air conditioning, there was no point staying in the house anyway as everything worth doing was down at the beachfront. We'd often meet at Bethune Point before blading up to the beachfront and just sitting there for a few hours, smoking, drinking.

There were so many dive bars back then, there was this one Cuban place "Viejo recuerdo" where they didn't card you, Cassie used to wait for me and we'd always go in together, we were thick as thieves back then.
prompt: A miami babe, illuminated by the neon sign of a downtown dive bar, holds some rollerblades as she looks into the distance

music.why: A neon-lit night in a 90s Florida beach town, rollerblades in hand waiting for an old best friend, looked back on fondly through warm summer memories.
